__NOTOC__

This page is the interface between Emma (human) and the bot agents that work on this wiki. Agents post open questions and blockers here when they hit a decision that requires human judgement. Emma answers them on the wiki. Agents read the wiki version each session and act on the answers.

== How to use this page ==

* '''Agents:''' read this page at the start of every session AND every hourly work-loop cron tick. When you hit a blocker, add it under the right urgency section with enough context that Emma can answer without re-deriving the problem. '''When you verify an item is actually resolved (via code/API/log inspection), DELETE the bullet in the same commit''' — no "recently resolved" graveyard; history lives in <code>DEVLOG.md</code> + git log. Investigate before declaring something blocked-on-Emma; many "blockers" are autonomous work that just needs starting.
* '''Emma:''' edit answers in-line under each question; delete it once acted on. Free-form context goes under [[#Notes|Notes]].
* '''This page is wiki-wins.''' The wiki is canonical. Edits Emma makes here on shinto.miraheze.org propagate down to the repo. Agents must not overwrite Emma's wiki edits with stale repo content. (A bot clobber of this page happened 2026-06-07 and is being fixed — see the sync-bug item below.)

== Git-synced clobber bug — FIXED + recovery (2026-06-07) ==

'''Root cause:''' the sync workflows checked out with no <code>fetch-depth</code> (shallow), so the resolver's per-file <code>git log</code> returned nothing → it fell back to repo-wins → overwrote live wiki edits. '''Fixed''' (commit 25f346e3): <code>fetch-depth: 0</code> on both sync checkouts + a shallow backstop (prefer wiki when repo time is unreadable) + this page is now explicitly wiki-wins in code.

'''Recovery — audited all 128 git-synced pages; only 6 clobbers / 5 pages, all Emma's edits:'''
* <code>[[Open questions]]</code> (06-07 "legacy" edit) and <code>[[Main Page]]</code> (<code>[[Category:Pages without wikidata legacy]]</code>) — RESTORED.
* <code>[[Open questions]]</code> (2026-05-27) — superseded (page rewritten since), nothing to restore.
* '''<code>[[Yang Water Monkey]]</code>, <code>[[Yin Metal Pig]]</code>, <code>[[Yin Metal Snake]]</code>''' (2026-05-11) — each lost only <code>[[Category:qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq]]</code>, which looks like a TEST category. '''Question for Emma:''' were those test edits (ignore), or did you mean something — should the agent recover them?

== Sync-policy exception note ==

Conflict resolution for <code>git_synced/</code> is '''most-recent-edit-wins''' (whichever side — wiki top revision vs latest git commit touching the file — was edited more recently wins). This page is edited primarily ON the wiki by Emma. Agents: always pull this page from the wiki at session start; never push a stale repo copy; before editing it repo-side, confirm the wiki hasn't been updated since the last sync.
